title: RES=RAG and the Coherent State Network Protocol: A Formal Architecture for Endogenous Stability in Human-Machine Systems
description: Version 1.1.0 formalizes the RES=RAG / Coherent State Network Protocol architecture with signed RES/RAG temporal displacement, an operational four-stage semantic interaction cycle, a falsifiable multi-task braking intervention, and provenance-labelled research claims. It preserves the v1.0 bounded non-zero Wasserstein equilibrium, local calibration requirement, reference classifier, RFC 8785/JCS canonicalization, and SHA-256 receipt chaining. Reported values such as 0.42, 0.66, and approximately 2.14 are not treated as universal constants unless validated under the exact operational metric profile.
